redirect.text: Write the text `Hej från shell` (Swedish for “Hello from the shell”) to the file `~/hej.txt` using `echo` and `>`.

append.text: Add another line to `~/hej.txt` – without overwriting the first one.

count-errors.text: Count the number of lines containing `ERROR` in server.log by piping `grep` into `wc -l`.

uniq.text: Show how many times each fruit appears in `frukter.txt`, using `sort` and `uniq -c`.

save-ls.text: Save a list of the files in `/etc` to the file `~/etc-filer.txt`.

devnull.text: Run `ls /finnsinte`, but send the error message to `/dev/null` so that nothing shows up.
